WATCH: Campus journalists and media students hold a candle-lighting for the victims of the Ampatuan Massacre in front of Plaridel Hall, Thursday, in commemoration of the massacre’s 16th anniversary. 

The protest action is part of Break Free, the annual month-long campaign spearheaded by Union of Journalists of the Philippines - UP Diliman to address the culture of impunity against journalists and promote media literacy. 

This year’s campaign, with the theme “Challenging Unchecked Power: The Role of Media in Holding Power to Account,” is in partnership with the College of Mass Communication Student Council, Diliman University Student Council, and UP Solidaridad.

#BreakFree2025
#EndImpunity

Ilang kalsada sa Quezon City ang inikutan ng Swift Traffic Action Group ngayong araw bilang bahagi ng anti-illegal parking operations.

20th Avenue, Maginhawa St., at Masaya St. ang sinuyod ng grupo para hulihin ang mga sasakyang naka-illegal parking at maisyuhan ng tiket ang mga lumabag sa tamang dress code o iyong mga naka-tsinelas habang nagmamaneho ng motor o kaya'y mali o walang helmet na suot.

Nasa 121 ang kabuuang nahuli kung saan 114 ang nakunan ng video gamit ang mga body-worn camera para sa non-contact apprehension habang pito naman ang agad na natiketan.

#mmda #STAG
